{
    "group": "BarSeriesManager.run(Strategy,int,int) - basic and edge cases",
    "cases": [
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "0"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "10"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "non‑null TradingRecord instance containing the trades generated by the strategy between indexes 0 and 10",
            "description": "Happy‑path test: a proper Strategy implementation is supplied together with a valid start and finish index. The method should delegate to the overloaded run and return a populated TradingRecord."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "5"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "5"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "non‑null TradingRecord instance with zero trades (empty record)",
            "description": "Edge case where startIndex equals finishIndex. No bars are processed, so the resulting TradingRecord should be empty but not null."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "8"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "3"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "IllegalArgumentException",
            "description": "Invalid range: startIndex is greater than finishIndex. The method is expected to validate the range and throw an IllegalArgumentException."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "-1"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "4"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "IllegalArgumentException",
            "description": "Negative startIndex should be rejected. The method should throw an IllegalArgumentException indicating that indexes must be non‑negative."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "null"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "0"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "5"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "NullPointerException",
            "description": "Null Strategy argument. The method must not accept a null strategy and should throw a NullPointerException (or a custom IllegalArgumentException) before delegating."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "1000"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "1010"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "IndexOutOfBoundsException",
            "description": "Start index exceeds the size of the underlying BarSeries. The method should detect the out‑of‑range index and throw an IndexOutOfBoundsException."
        },
        {
            "input": [
                {
                    "parameter": "strategy",
                    "value": "validStrategyMock"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "startIndex",
                    "value": "0"
                },
                {
                    "parameter": "finishIndex",
                    "value": "1000"
                }
            ],
            "expected": "IndexOutOfBoundsException",
            "description": "Finish index exceeds the size of the BarSeries. The method should validate the upper bound and throw an IndexOutOfBoundsException."
        }
    ]
}
